name: Historic Monuments of Ancient Kyoto (Kyoto, Uji and Otsu Cities)
description: Seventeen temples, shrines and one castle are scattered across Kyoto and the neighbouring cities of Uji and Otsu, remnants of Japan's imperial capital, founded in 794 and modelled on Chinese cities. Thirteen are Buddhist temples, many with graceful wooden halls and celebrated gardens. Together they hold 38 National Treasure buildings and show how Japanese architecture and garden design developed over a thousand years.
